The building will have a footprint of 5 x 2.8 and a height of 4.5, featuring stepped masses and recessed windows. I’m considering a flat color palette with shades of raw concrete.

**Designing building details**

I want to use BoxGeometry and cylinders for about 250 parts, focusing on concise but detailed code with helper functions to keep things organized. The building will have dimensions of 5.8 in width and 3.4 in depth, with a height of 4.6. The main structure features a brutalist stepped upper design with alternating balconies and dark recessed windows for depth and layering.

If each frame has four sections, that could mean 120 frames total, but I can consider using vertical or horizontal bars for better aesthetics. The windows will be dark boxes measuring 0.62 by 0.42 by 0.04, with frame strips around them. I’m thinking of adding four balconies on the sides in an alternating pattern, along with an entry door.
